title: Antigua Guatemala Cathedral
visualBrief: Complete native surviving cathedral: cream west Baroque facade/parish with3recessed timber doors/blue radial fanlights, paired engaged columns, lower and upper saint niches, scroll shoulders/raised ornament, urns and central crown; separate lower southern parish wing/roofs. Full eastern roofless ruin extent with battered brick/plaster walls, articulated compound piers/capitals, real open transverse/lateral arches and thin broken vault-edge fragments around the20mapped roof voids. Bounded intrinsic nave floor/entrance steps/iron fence only. Lost bell towers and complete old dome/roof absent. Native perimeters/voids exact, structural sections/elevations/hidden details photo-estimated.
